python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys,time,os,sqlite3,shutil

PKG="io.blueeye"
def run(args,timeout=8,binary=False):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,text=not binary)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return None

def s22():
    p=run(["adb","devices"],3)
    if not p: return None
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1]=="device":
            serial=parts[0]
            q=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","getprop","ro.product.model"],3)
            if q and q.stdout.strip()=="SM-S906B": return serial
    return None

serial=s22()
if not serial:
    m=run(["adb","mdns","services"],6)
    eps=[]
    if m:
        for line in m.stdout.splitlines():
            if "_adb-tls-connect._tcp" in line:
                for token in reversed(line.split()):
                    if re.search(r":\d+$",token):
                        eps.append(token); break
    for ep in eps:
        run(["adb","connect",ep],4); time.sleep(.4)
        serial=s22()
        if serial: break
if not serial:
    print("S22_ADB_UNREACHABLE"); sys.exit(42)

# Observe active collection without touching the app for 60s.
start=int(time.time())
time.sleep(60)

log=run(["adb","-s",serial,"logcat","-d","-v","epoch"],15)
txt=log.stdout if log else ""
recent=[]
for line in txt.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\s+",line)
    if m and int(m.group(1)) >= start-30:
        recent.append(line)
patterns={
 "enabled":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Auto active GATT collection enabled",
 "queued":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Queued auto active GATT probe",
 "started":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Starting auto active GATT probe",
 "timeout":r"AutoActiveProbe.*probe timeout",
 "read_ok":r"BleManager.*Read Char:",
 "read_done":r"BleManager.*Finished reading all characteristics",
 "read_failed":r"BleManager.*Failed to read",
 "conn_failed":r"BleManager.*Connection Failed/Lost|Connection Failed/Lost",
}
counts={k:sum(1 for l in recent if re.search(p,l)) for k,p in patterns.items()}
print("AUTO_GATT_LOG_60S "+" ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in counts.items()))

# Briefly stop the app so the Room database/WAL is quiescent and can be copied consistently.
run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","am","force-stop",PKG],5)
time.sleep(2)

base="/tmp/tracker-auto-gatt-quiescent"
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
for name in ("tracker_database","tracker_database-wal","tracker_database-shm"):
    p=run(["adb","-s",serial,"exec-out","run-as",PKG,"sh","-c",f"cat databases/{name} 2>/dev/null || true"],20,binary=True)
    data=b"" if p is None else p.stdout
    open(os.path.join(base,name),"wb").write(data)

work=os.path.join(base,"db")
shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(base,"tracker_database"),work)
for name,suf in (("tracker_database-wal","-wal"),("tracker_database-shm","-shm")):
    src=os.path.join(base,name)
    if os.path.exists(src) and os.path.getsize(src)>0:
        shutil.copyfile(src,work+suf)

con=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{work}?mode=ro",uri=True)
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
ok=con.execute("pragma quick_check").fetchone()[0]
now=int(time.time()*1000)
rows=list(con.execute("""
 select lastProbeTimestamp,connectionStatus,connectionAttempts,gattServices,characteristicData,
        modelNumber,serialNumber,firmwareRevision,hardwareRevision,softwareRevision,
        manufacturerName,batteryLevel,probeError
 from devices
 where lastProbeTimestamp > ?
 order by lastProbeTimestamp desc
""",(now-30*60*1000,)))
def ne(v): return v is not None and str(v).strip()!=""
print("GATT_DB quick_check=%s recent_probe_devices=%d attempts_sum=%d with_services=%d with_characteristics=%d with_standard_fields=%d with_errors=%d newest_probe_age_ms=%d" % (
    ok,
    len(rows),
    sum(int(r["connectionAttempts"] or 0) for r in rows),
    sum(ne(r["gattServices"]) for r in rows),
    sum(ne(r["characteristicData"]) for r in rows),
    sum(any(ne(r[k]) for k in ("modelNumber","serialNumber","firmwareRevision","hardwareRevision","softwareRevision","manufacturerName")) or r["batteryLevel"] is not None for r in rows),
    sum(ne(r["probeError"]) for r in rows),
    -1 if not rows else max(0,now-int(rows[0]["lastProbeTimestamp"]))
))
sample=con.execute("select count(*) c,max(timestamp) m from signal_samples where timestamp>?",(now-2*60*1000,)).fetchone()
print("SCANNER_DB samples_2m=%d newest_age_ms=%d" % (
    int(sample["c"]),
    -1 if sample["m"] is None else max(0,now-int(sample["m"]))
))
con.close()

# Relaunch app and verify persisted master-switch state re-enables coordinator.
resolve=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","cmd","package","resolve-activity","--brief","-c","android.intent.category.LAUNCHER",PKG],5)
activity=(resolve.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if resolve and resolve.stdout.strip() else "")
if activity and "/" in activity:
    run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","am","start","-n",activity],8)
else:
    run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","monkey","-p",PKG,"-c","android.intent.category.LAUNCHER","1"],8)
time.sleep(12)

post=run(["adb","-s",serial,"logcat","-d","-v","epoch"],12)
posttxt=post.stdout if post else ""
restart_epoch=int(time.time())-15
postlines=[]
for line in posttxt.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\s+",line)
    if m and int(m.group(1)) >= restart_epoch:
        postlines.append(line)
reenabled=sum(1 for l in postlines if re.search(r"AutoActiveProbe.*Auto active GATT collection enabled",l))
pid=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","pidof",PKG],3)
alive=bool(pid and pid.stdout.strip())
fatal=sum(1 for l in recent+postlines if "FATAL EXCEPTION" in l or "ANR in io.blueeye" in l)
print(f"POST_RESTART auto_gatt_enabled_events={reenabled} process_alive={'yes' if alive else 'no'} fatal_or_anr={fatal}")
if ok!="ok" or not alive or fatal:
    sys.exit(44)
PY
